title: Municipal service administration
description: Municipal operations tie residents, properties, permits, requests, inspections, work orders, contracts, budgets, and fees to responsible departments.
workflow: Receive a resident request, issue and inspect permits, schedule contracted asset work, assign staff and materials, post the expense, and collect permit fees.
limitations: All residents and locations are synthetic. Money is integer BRL cents and dates are ISO text. The violation table includes cleared observations with zero fines so every inspection has a representative record. Public-record disclosure, personal-data protection, legal deadlines, appeals, procurement compliance, multi-year appropriations, and audit authorization require a broader design.
